learnings.question: Which 20th-century figure argued in 1971 that an abundance of information inevitably creates a scarcity of attention?
learnings.learning: Herbert Simon wrote in 1971 that "the wealth of information means a dearth of... attention" — in an information-rich world, attention itself becomes the scarce resource.
learnings.articleTitle: Everybody wants your attention, but not everything deserves it.

learnings.question: According to a hadith narrated by Abu Hurayrah found in the 40 Hadith an-Nawawi collection, what is part of the perfection of a person's Islam?
options: Leaving that which does not concern him
learnings.learning: Hadith 12 of 40 Hadith an-Nawawi states: "Part of the perfection of one's Islam is his leaving that which does not concern him" — a direct call to filter out what doesn't matter.
learnings.articleTitle: Everybody wants your attention, but not everything deserves it.

learnings.question: What term describes the psychological phenomenon where writing information down, or storing it digitally, causes the brain to deprioritize remembering it?
learnings.learning: Psychologists call it the "Performance Paradox" of Cognitive Offloading — the moment we write something down or save it digitally, our brain treats that as permission to forget it.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: Which 19th-century researcher, working in the 1880s, demonstrated that people forget about 80% of newly learned information within 24 hours unless they actively work to recall it?
learnings.learning: Back in the 1880s, Hermann Ebbinghaus proved we forget about 80% of what we learn within 24 hours unless we actively force ourselves to recall it — simply re-reading doesn't work.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: In the Scrum framework, which artifact visually tracks the amount of work remaining in a sprint to show whether the team is on schedule?
learnings.learning: The Burndown Chart is one of Scrum's three artifacts — it visualizes sprint progress, shows remaining work, and helps the team track whether they're on schedule.

learnings.question: In Scrum, which role is specifically responsible for protecting the development team from distractions and resolving blockers, rather than managing the project directly?
learnings.learning: The Scrum Master's job is to protect the team from distractions and facilitate the Scrum process — notably, "Project Manager" is explicitly not one of Scrum's three key roles.

learnings.question: In Islamic teaching on the purpose of life, humanity's role centers on worship and serving as caretakers (khalifah) of the Earth — what is the third primary role?
options: Preparing for the eternal Hereafter through accountability
learnings.learning: Life's purpose in Islam revolves around three roles: worshiping Allah, serving as khalifah (stewards) of the Earth, and preparing for the eternal Hereafter through conscious choices and accountability.

learnings.question: What Arabic term refers to a mindful awareness of God's presence that builds self-restraint and purifies a person's intentions?
learnings.learning: Taqwa is the mindfulness or awareness of Allah's presence that worship fosters — it builds self-restraint, purifies intentions, and guides a person away from wrongdoing.

learnings.question: What is the core lesson of the Quranic teaching that "whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it, and whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it"?
options: Good deeds automatically cancel out bad ones
No deed, no matter how small, goes unaccounted for
learnings.learning: This verse (Quran 99:7-8) teaches that in Allah's divine justice, every deed — however tiny — is accounted for, reinforcing fairness and motivating righteous living.

learnings.question: In PCIe power management, which state has the device almost completely powered down, used for the longest periods of inactivity, with the highest power savings but the longest wake-up time?
learnings.learning: L2 is the deepest PCIe power state — the device is almost completely powered down, maximizing energy savings at the cost of the longest delay to resume activity.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: Which PCIe power state is designed specifically for very short durations of idleness, comparable to a computer screen turning off while the system can resume quickly?
learnings.learning: L0s is a very light sleep state designed for brief idle periods — the link can quickly "wake up" to resume full activity, similar to a computer screen turning off.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: In Islamic theology, which term refers to the actual, unfolding occurrence of events in a person's life, as distinct from Allah's eternal, pre-written plan?
learnings.learning: Qada' refers to the actual occurrence of events as they unfold, shaped by our actions and decisions — distinct from Qadr, which is Allah's complete, eternal plan.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada' and Qadr

learnings.question: According to a hadith narrated by Ubadah bin As-Samit, what happens when a Muslim sincerely supplicates (makes Dua) to Allah for something that isn't sinful and doesn't sever family ties?
options: Allah grants it, or wards off an equivalent evil from them
Nothing happens unless it's done after Fajr prayer
learnings.learning: Per Jami at-Tirmidhi 3573, when a Muslim calls upon Allah with any permissible supplication, Allah either grants it or turns away an equivalent amount of evil from them.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada' and Qadr

learnings.question: When a data analysis tested whether the Pareto Principle (80/20 rule) applies to word frequency in the Quran, what percentage of the Quran's text did the top 20 most frequent words actually account for?
learnings.learning: A Python word-frequency analysis found the top 20 most common words in the Quran accumulate to only about 20.83% of the text — the Pareto Principle's 80/20 split didn't hold.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: What term refers to the small diacritical markings placed above or below Arabic letters to indicate vowel sounds and pronunciation?
learnings.learning: Tashkeel are the small markings added above or below Arabic letters to indicate vowel sounds; without them, the same spelling can be read multiple ways.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python
